## Fleshrender (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
CE Medium undead  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 14, touch 12, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +2 natural)  
**hp** 36 (5d8+12)  
**Fort** +2, **Ref** +3, **Will** +5  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +6  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +4 (1d8+2)  
**Special Attacks** consume flesh  


**Statistics**


**Str** 15; **Dex** 15, Con —; **Int** 13; **Wis** 14; **Cha** 14  
**Base Atk** +2; **CMB** +3; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Weapon Finesse, Improved Grapple, Improved Unarmed Strike  
**Skills** Acrobatics +4, Climb +6, Perception +7, Stealth +7  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Consume Flesh (Su)** A fleshrender can consume flesh from a grappled opponent. If the fleshrender successfully grapples an opponent and deals subsequent physical damage, the flreshrender heals 4 hit points or gains 4 temporary hit points for 1 hour (up to a maximum number of temporary hit points equal to its full normal hit points).  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land  
**Organization** solitary, group (2–4), party (5-20)  
**Treasure** standard
